scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @opsflow/web" "npm run dev -w @opsflow/api" "npm run dev -w @opsflow/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @opsflow/shared && npm run build -w @opsflow/config
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @opsflow/api && npm run build -w @opsflow/worker && npm run build -w @opsflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:generate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate -w @opsflow/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate -w @opsflow/api
scripts.services:check: npm run build:packages && npm run services:check -w @opsflow/api
